draft.emotion: a bit scattered and apologetic, realizing you left something behind
notes: Can be followed by a noun (forget a thing or fact) or directly by a verb (forget to do something).
To say you left something behind somewhere, use ลืม...ไว้ (e.g., ลืมกุญแจไว้ที่บ้าน 'left my keys at home').
Also appears in the common expression ลืมตา ('to open one's eyes').
